title: What's on a Swedish fika table? ☕ Learn Swedish (A2)
text:
What do Swedes put on the table for fika? ☕
Name every drink and treat in Swedish, then learn how to invite a colleague for a break.

📝 "Kaffe. Te. Mjölk."
↳ Coffee. Tea. Milk.

📝 "En kanelbulle. En kardemummabulle."
↳ A cinnamon bun. A cardamom bun.

📝 "En chokladboll. En hallongrotta. En bit tårta."
↳ A chocolate oat ball. A raspberry jam cookie. A slice of cake.

📝 "Ska vi ta en fika? — Ja, gärna!"
↳ Shall we have a fika? — Yes, I'd love to!

🎓 You learn:
• fika = a coffee break to share with others
• kanel = cinnamon, kardemumma = cardamom, hallon = raspberry
• en bit tårta = a slice of cake
• Ska vi ta en fika? / Ja, gärna! = invite and accept
